dedupe_keys.name: ntra egypt mobile quality of service drive test reports and road mobile coverage map

description: Egypt's National Telecom Regulatory Authority carries out field measurements of the licensed mobile network operators, Orange, Vodafone, Etisalat (e& Egypt) and WE, using standard quality of service methods. The measurements cover areas, neighbourhoods and main roads in Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, the Delta, the Canal zone, the Red Sea and Upper Egypt, and report indicators for voice, data and video streaming: blocked call rate, dropped call rate, speech quality, download and upload speeds and others. Results were published monthly and then quarterly from January 2021; the reports page lists quarters from the second quarter of 2021 to the first quarter of 2024. A roads mobile coverage map from October 2020 shows measured coverage along the national road network as an image, and a key performance indicator page defines the measures. Coverage: Egypt, cities and main roads, by operator. Format and access: web pages and report documents on the authority's site, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: reports stop in early 2024 on the list; the coverage map is an image, not data; report formats were not checked. Simulation uses: measured operator performance and road coverage for Egyptian mobile service models and for checking modelled coverage. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give national series; the Ookla open data performance tiles give crowdsourced speeds for Egypt.
